info.name: Feature Flag Service
info.description:
Run folders top-to-bottom. Each folder depends on variables set by earlier folders.

Flow: Health → Tenants → Auth → Flags(Create→Configure→Read→Archive) → Evaluation → Audit → Tenant Isolation

Required: app running on localhost:3000 (`make up` or `make dev` + `make db-up`)

Every run creates fresh tenants (names are timestamped) so re-runs never conflict.
